bodyHtml:
🚀 Onsite Or Remote · Logan & Surrounds

Computer Tune-Up Logan. Speed It Up & Clean It Out.

Your computer should work fast, efficiently, and without frustrating delays. If your PC or Mac has become sluggish, takes forever to start up, or is filled with unnecessary files and programs, our computer tune-up and clean-up service is the perfect solution, onsite or remote.

Speed Up My Computer
✓ Boost System Speed
✓ Remove Junk & Bloat
✓ Malware Scan Included
✓ Onsite & Remote
Why Your Computer Needs A Tune-Up

A Computer Is Like A Car, It Needs Regular Maintenance.

Over time, unnecessary files, outdated software and security threats slow down your system. Common signs it's time for a tune-up: slow performance, frequent freezing or crashing, overheating and loud fan noise, too many startup programs, and pop-ups or strange behaviour that could mean malware or bloatware.

Our Approach

Onsite & Remote Computer Optimisation.

We help you boost system speed and reduce lag, remove junk files and unnecessary programs, optimise startup programs and improve boot times, scan and remove malware or security threats, and improve overall performance and longevity, whether we're on your doorstep or connected securely online.

What's Included

What Our Computer Tune-Up & Clean-Up Service Includes.

A comprehensive approach to computer maintenance, ensuring your system is optimised for speed, security and stability.

🩺

Initial System Assessment

We run diagnostics to check system health, identify performance issues, and determine the best tune-up strategy.

🗑️

Removing Unnecessary Files & Programs

Deleting temporary files, clearing cache, and uninstalling unwanted software.

🦠

Malware & Virus Scan

Scanning for spyware, adware and viruses that slow down performance, see our dedicated virus removal service for active infections.

🔄

System Optimisation & Updates

Updating your operating system and software for maximum efficiency and security.

⏱️

Startup Program Management

Disabling unnecessary background programs to speed up boot time.

✅

Final Performance Check

Ensuring everything is running at peak performance before completing the service, with your approval.

Onsite & Remote

Whichever Suits You Best.

🏠

Onsite Service

We come to your home or office to diagnose and optimise your PC or Mac in person.

💻

Remote Service

We securely connect to your computer online and perform the tune-up remotely, no waiting around required.

Speed Up My Computer
Pricing & Packages

Tune-Up Packages Tailored To Your Needs.

Every job is different, so we give you a straight quote over the phone before we book it in. No hidden fees.

Basic

Basic Tune-Up

  • General system clean-up
  • Speed boost
Security

Malware Removal & Security Check

  • Comprehensive virus scan
  • Protection updates
Full Service

Advanced Optimisation

  • Includes security scans
  • Full performance improvements

Get in touch for a quote, most tune-ups take 1 to 2 hours, depending on the system's condition.

Related Services

Pair Your Tune-Up With These.

  • Windows still feels bloated after a clean-up? Our Windows de-bloat & customisation service strips out the clutter for good.
  • System still not right? A clean OS install or repair may be the better fix for deeper corruption.
  • Not backed up yet? Get data backup & transfer sorted before any major clean-up.
  • Overdue for regular care? Ask about preventative maintenance so it doesn't slow down again.
Frequently Asked Questions

Computer Tune-Up Questions, Answered.

How do I speed up my slow computer?

A computer tune-up removes unnecessary files, optimises software, and improves overall performance.

What does a computer tune-up include?

It includes removing junk files, updating software, scanning for malware, and optimising system settings.

Can I clean up my PC without losing files?

Yes. Our clean-up service ensures no personal files are deleted, only unnecessary system clutter is removed.

How often should I get a computer tune-up?

At least once a year for general maintenance, or every 6 months if you use your computer heavily.

What's the difference between a tune-up and a full reset?

A tune-up improves performance without deleting your files, while a full reset restores factory settings.

Do you offer onsite and remote computer cleaning?

Yes, we provide both onsite service and remote tune-ups for convenience.

How long does a computer clean-up take?

Most tune-ups take 1 to 2 hours, depending on the system's condition.

Can a tune-up remove viruses?

Yes, we scan and remove malware, adware and spyware that could be slowing down your system.

Will a tune-up make my PC faster?

Absolutely. A tune-up removes unnecessary clutter and optimises system settings to improve speed.

How do I book a service?

Get in touch and I'll get your computer running like new.
